_comment: Reference/comparison figures only — NOT measured. Real-world figures for a vehicle of similar type/class to each catalog variant, used by measure_vehicles.gd to put a plausible real-world number beside each measured one in the sweep report. `marks_s` keys match the km/h marks the tool times (50, 96.56 = 0-60 mph, 100, 150, 200); a missing key means that speed is not realistic for the class and prints as 'not reached'.

sedan-sports.label: typical mid-size sports sedan (e.g. BMW M340i class)

sedan.label: typical mid-size family sedan (e.g. Toyota Camry class)

hatchback-sports.label: typical hot hatch (e.g. VW Golf GTI class)

suv.label: typical mid-size crossover SUV (e.g. Toyota RAV4 class)

suv-luxury.label: typical performance luxury SUV (e.g. Porsche Cayenne class)

taxi.label: typical taxi-duty sedan (e.g. Toyota Camry/Prius class)

police.label: typical police pursuit-rated SUV/sedan (e.g. Ford Police Interceptor / Dodge Charger Pursuit class)

race.label: typical track-day sports/race car (e.g. Radical/Ariel Atom class)

race-future.label: typical modern electric hypercar (e.g. Rimac Nevera class)

van.label: typical full-size cargo van (e.g. Ford Transit class)

pickup.label: typical full-size pickup (e.g. Ford F-150 class)

pickup-flat.label: typical full-size pickup with flatbed/utility body (e.g. Ford F-250 class)

delivery.label: typical light delivery van (e.g. Mercedes Sprinter class)

delivery-flat.label: typical light delivery/box van, laden (e.g. Mercedes Sprinter box class)

ambulance.label: typical Type III ambulance (heavy van chassis, e.g. Mercedes Sprinter/Ford E-450 class)

garbage-truck.label: typical rear-loader refuse truck, laden (e.g. Mack LR class)

firetruck.label: typical Type I structural fire engine (e.g. Pierce Enforcer class)

semi.label: typical Class 8 semi tractor-trailer, loaded to ~36 t (e.g. Freightliner Cascadia + van trailer)

semi-conventional.label: typical North American conventional semi tractor-trailer, loaded to ~36 t (e.g. Peterbilt 579 + van trailer)

tractor-kenney.label: typical mid-size farm tractor (e.g. John Deere 6R class, road gear)
